title: Steps and summary tables: size from remaining agent hours, latest estimate, Status with its colour
goal: The generated ledger shows sizes that follow the remaining agent time, the latest estimate instead of the baseline, and one Status column
acceptance: Steps table Effort | Step | Estimate | Actual | Remaining | Status; no (planned …) suffix
Size from remaining agent hours only: up to 1 h Small, 4 h Medium, 8 h Large, more Very large; days steps keep the authored size
Totals 'N h agent + M h owner', no zero unit
Generated summary merges Signal into Status; check-backlog, backlog-queue and solution read it
Regression tests; rules both copies; CHANGELOG and APPLY
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Judged 2026-11-12: 3 agent hours from F-059, which changed the summary table across the same readers. Implemented the same day; 1 h left for review fixes and the release. Released in v7.0.0 (PR #133); stated actual about 2.75 h including the review fixes.
